section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants for a single study (Study X) consisting of 249 college women from a Midwestern U.S. university, with a mean age of 19.1 years and 86.3% identifying as White/Caucasian. The sample was predominantly first-year students (77.1%), representing 100% college-level education or higher, with diverse socioeconomic backgrounds ranging from working class to upper class.
